sources.command: git log --since='7 days ago' --first-parent origin/dev --pretty=oneline | wc -l

lead_time_seconds.definition: mergedAt minus createdAt for merged pull requests returned by the GitHub query

interpretation.throughput_baseline: 137 merged PRs to dev in the measured window; 3 were merged on 2026-05-18 before this baseline.
interpretation.latency_baseline: Median PR lead time is 1265 seconds; p90 is 14601 seconds; PR 143 is the max-latency outlier in the recent sample.
limitations: Git first-parent commit count includes non-PR commits and squash merge commits; use the GitHub PR count as the primary throughput baseline.
GitHub query is live API data and may change if history or PR metadata changes.
This baseline measures create-to-merge lead time, not CI-only time-to-green because check-run timeline extraction is a separate heavier query.

validation: gh pr list returned 137 merged PRs for merged:>=2026-05-11 base:dev.
git first-parent count returned 208 commits for the same 7-day local window.
local HEAD and origin/dev both resolved to 7ab3118e97939a9cb5abd509a78fe1988cd2809f before this session's edits.
